comparison_note: Fresh full Vail inventory: all 108 parameterized upstream Table and MatrixTable cases, with upstream skips respected. Exact upstream inputs/dimensions, one fresh-process attempt per case. Local 14 logical CPU / 96 GiB machine; 32 GiB process-tree RSS guard during fixture preparation and queries. Query limit 120 seconds unless the upstream timeout is longer; fixture limit 900 seconds. Query time excludes fixture preparation and engine startup. Hail results reused: same-machine baselines where available, otherwise historical 32-vCPU Linux VM results shown as references without speedup ratios. No Hail reruns.
title: Full upstream Table and MatrixTable benchmarks
